items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you got Christian McBride on bass and Lewis Nash on drums

ctx.x: But you [Brown] worded that very well (laughs).

Now this one again was recorded in 2000 and continuing on in the Telarc catalog you had a group that seemed to be . . . at least the rhythm section, this is Illuminations which I believe garnered a Grammy award if not a nomination-I’ll go back and double check that before I embarrass myself. But this one . . . Gary Bartz back in the fold now you got Christian McBride on bass and Lewis Nash on drums when I saw you in 2005 at the Coltrane memorial concert you had Lewis Nash and Gary Bartz.
